corroboration: PRIMARY, and the reason these are addresses and not guesses: data/record-clearing/legal-design-intake/LA.memo.json records an officialSourceUrl of the form https://www.legis.la.gov/legis/Law.aspx?d=<id> for every article from 972 to 999.1. For the six articles whose print view is mounted here, I read the PDF with pdftotext and compared the id the memo assigns against the id the PDF prints in its own page footer. Six of six match exactly: 984/919676, 990/919685, 993/919688, 995/919691, 998/1335832, 999.1/1386723. The memo's article-to-id mapping is therefore verified against six documents whose bytes I read, and the six ids it assigns to the missing articles come from that same verified mapping.

SECOND: the Master Library's own Louisiana legal review, STATES/LA/01_LEGAL_REVIEW/...ASOF-2026-07-30__EN.md, states in Part 2: 'Official source: https://www.legis.la.gov, Law.aspx by article. All uploaded HTML files are print views from that site.' That is the publisher and the URL scheme asserted by a document shipped inside the source archive itself.

THIRD: three further committed records carry the same six ids independently of the memo -- data/rcap-grade-a/source-acquisition/wave-1/acquired.json (as uniqueOfficialTargets with obligationKeys), data/rcap-grade-a/route-obligation-census-v1/identity-resolution/batch-2/resolved.json (as officialSourceUrl per obligation), and data/record-clearing/legal-design-track-source-relationships.json.

FOURTH, structural: 991=919686 and 992=919687 fall in a fully closed interval between two independently PDF-verified ids, 990=919685 and 993=919688 -- exactly two slots for exactly two articles, with no room for error. Those two are interval-locked.
theAddressesEstablished.theHonestCaveat: 987, 988, 989 and 994 are NOT interval-locked. Between PDF-verified 984=919676 and PDF-verified 990=919685 there are eight slots for six articles (985, 985.1, 986, 987, 988, 989), leaving two unassigned; between 993=919688 and 995=919691 there are two slots for one article (994), leaving one unassigned. The memo's assignment for these four is corroborated by four committed records and by a mapping verified six-for-six, but not closed by arithmetic. So the acquiring lane must do one thing on arrival for each of the four: read the fetched page's printed heading and confirm it begins 'Art. 987.' / 'Art. 988.' / 'Art. 989.' / 'Art. 994.' -- the same one-line check that would have caught a wrong id. Do not skip it for 991 and 992 either; it costs nothing.
theAddressesEstablished.aboutTheNationwideDigests: data/rcap-all50/nationwide-source-inventory.json pins a sha256 for each of the six as saved legislature HTML (987 6f1498a70bc0..., 988 efa0a8631a1c..., 989 4c593e60f5c0..., 991 a6872580f648..., 992 fc715f0eea69..., 994 07b0ad437bcd...). consumptionNotes.forTheAcquisitionLane: The six Louisiana URLs are ready to dispatch to scripts/rcap-acquire-official-source.mjs against www.legis.la.gov. Read the printed article heading on each fetched page and confirm it matches the article requested before binding -- mandatory for 987, 988, 989 and 994, cheap for 991 and 992.
consumptionNotes.forTheCompositionLaneThatFollows: When the Louisiana articles arrive, the owner determination is already made and needs no re-escalation: compose faithfully from the codified article text, preserving statutory language, structure, signature roles, certifications and orders, and customise only the court name that Art. 986(C) permits. Two live drafting traps recorded by the prior pass and confirmed here: art. 988's fee-exemption certification must reach the district attorney BEFORE filing, because art. 983 has the clerk collect at filing and the fees are nonrefundable even on denial -- a packet that produces the motion first has cost the participant $550; and art. 983(M)'s $300 marijuana cap terminated 2026-08-01, so a packet stating $300 states a repealed fee. The art. 983(A) cap is $550 with the art. 983(F) waiver.
consumptionNotes.labelResolutionCheck: Per the mid-task instruction, I checked whether any Florida or Louisiana official-form label resolves to an instruction sheet rather than a form. None does. Two placement oddities worth noting but not defects in label resolution: LA-CCRP-ART-984's print view is filed under STATES/LA/03_INSTRUCTIONS/ while the other five Louisiana article prints are under 05_SOURCE_GATED/, and in the Nationwide tree art. 990 sits under reference-only/ while 993, 995, 998 and 999.1 sit under source-gated/. In both cases the file itself is the article's own print view, not an instruction sheet.
